name: actionlog
description: Tamper-Evident Autonomous Agent Action Audit & Governance Logging MCP Server

tools.name: record_agent_action
tools.description: Records an autonomous agent decision or tool execution with cryptographic integrity hash.

agent_id.description: Unique identifier of the executing agent

action_type.description: Action category (e.g., tool_call, transaction, file_write, api_dispatch)

payload.description: JSON string containing execution parameters or outcome

tools.name: verify_log_integrity
tools.description: Audits sequential cryptographic checksums to ensure audit log has not been altered.

agent_id.description: Agent ID whose action log history will be verified

audit_depth.description: Number of recent log events to verify (default 50)
